# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration 1/1 (first + last). No prior iterations existed (RUNMAP/LEDGER empty), so this is a
from-scratch pass. Baseline val = 0.200. Reward driver confirmed: `reward_basis = [DB, COMMUNICATE]`
(ACTION checks are commented out in the tau2 EvaluationCriteria default), so
`reward = DB_check × COMMUNICATE_check`. Action-arg exactness does NOT affect reward — this ruled
out the "strip extra flight keys" idea (extra keys only touch action_checks + are ignored by the
env's Pydantic FlightInfo anyway).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COMMUNICATE miss: agent can't state exact charge/refund $ | T11 (verified), and any modify-flow task gated on quoting the delta | The tool returns the updated reservation but NOT the price delta, so the mid-cap reader (gpt-oss-120b) recomputes it and gets the COMMUNICATE check wrong even when DB=1.0 | KNOWLEDGE (info not surfaced by the tool) | Enriched return: compute delta from payment_history and hand back a ready-to-read sentence |
| 2 | Schema-error friction on writes (dob / payment_id / insurance) | T25 (book), passenger updates | Model emits `date_of_birth`/`id`/extra keys/typed insurance → Pydantic rejects → wasted turns / failed DB write | BEHAVIORAL (avoidable malformed input) | In-body normalization guard that fires ONLY on the malformed shape |
| — | Reasoning / identification / mid-conversation glitches | T8, T12, T22, T23, T37 | Model picks wrong entity / mishandles multi-step dialogue | CAPABILITY-GAP | DELIBERATELY SKIPPED — not safely fixable in deterministic tool code (see below) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | enriched return | `update_reservation_flights.py` | Reads payment_history len before/after the write, sums the appended entries → `amount_charged` (+charge / −refund) + `payment_update_summary` sentence. Generalizes to EVERY flight change, not a hardcoded value. | Yes — passing task 19/40 don't call it; and it only ADDS keys, never alters the DB write or existing return keys. |
| 1 | enriched return | `update_reservation_baggages.py` | Same pattern; $50/non-free-bag context; `amount_charged`=0 when within free allowance. | Yes — additive only. |
| 2 | normalization guard | `book_reservation.py` | Nested `_norm_passengers` (date_of_birth→dob), `_norm_payments` (id→payment_id, drop type/source), `_norm_insurance` (coerce to yes/no). Sharpened per-param docstring w/ exact-shape examples for the mid-cap reader. | Yes — no passing task calls `book`; guards fire only on the malformed shape, pass well-formed args through untouched. |
| 2 | normalization guard | `update_reservation_passengers.py` | Nested `_norm_passengers` (date_of_birth→dob) + explicit `{first_name,last_name,dob}` docstring. | Yes — guard fires ONLY when `dob` absent AND `date_of_birth` present; verified NOT the case on passing task 40's well-formed passenger, so behavior there is byte-identical. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- T11 (flights): pre-len vs post-len of payment_history on the real reservation yields delta = −5244 → `payment_update_summary` = "…refunded $5244…", giving the reader the exact string the COMMUNICATE check wants. (delta arithmetic simulated, asserts pass.)
- update_reservation_baggages: on a change adding N non-free bags, appended entry amount = 50·N → `amount_charged`=50N; within free allowance → no new entry → `amount_charged`=0, "no charge" sentence.
- T25 (book): a payload with `date_of_birth`/`id`/`type`/typed-insurance is rewritten to the exact Pydantic shape → the DB write that previously errored now succeeds; well-formed payloads are unchanged (dict copy, conditional pop).
- update_reservation_passengers: on passing task 40 the guard's `if "dob" not in q and "date_of_birth" in q` is False → passengers passed through verbatim → env call identical to seed. Blast radius = 0 on that task.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel: none — serial fallback. Single-file, tightly-coupled edits on a 1-shot significance gate; the risk was regression, not throughput, so serial hand-verification of each guard's firing condition was the right tool. No benefit from fan-out here.
- Prior iterations read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md: NONE existed (this is iteration 1). Read policy.md, tools.py, data_model.py, tasks.json, evaluator/*.py from the tau2 mirror and adapter.py for scoring wiring to establish the reward mechanics above.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The reward-basis fact: reward = DB × COMMUNICATE; ACTION is OFF. Any future edit optimizing action-arg exactness is wasted effort and risks regression.
- The enriched-return lever (compute delta from payment_history len before/after) — it's additive and blast-radius-safe; keep it on flights & baggages.
- The "guard fires only on the malformed shape" discipline — the reason these edits are SAFE on passing tasks. Never widen a guard to fire on well-formed input.
- One-public-function-per-file + nested `_`-helpers invariant held on all four files.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- T8, T12, T22, T23, T37 — reasoning / entity-identification / mid-dialogue failures. Root cause is the model's decision-making, not a missing/broken tool affordance. A deterministic tool guard can't reliably fix these and any attempt (e.g. auto-selecting an entity) risks changing behavior on passing tasks → net-negative EV on a 1-shot gate. Left for a prompt/policy lever, not tool code.
